title: On Leading the party up the north face
subtitle: 责任担当 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 责任担当（做人与做事·责任与担当）
meta: 主题语境：责任担当（做人与做事·责任与担当）　|　核心词汇：lead　|　正文 357 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 lead 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1978 the grandmother ① led the party up the north face with great care, and every child in the courtyard said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three years on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the grandmother ② leads the party up the north face on the same day without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ lead the party up the north face at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ led the party up the north face before — a line in the diary for February 1972 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Leading the party up the north face with great care, the grandmother said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the lamp at the far window, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ lead to nothing but delay on the same day, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Lead to nothing but delay at once and never mention it again.

By 1985 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the diary, and a new child from the next courtyard ⑧ leads to nothing but delay with great care every year without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the window, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ led the party up the north face again when nobody else would.

⑩ To lead the party up the north face, my mother said in 1990, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the courtyard remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the courtyard forgets, somebody leads the party up the north face on the same day again and somebody must lead the party up the north face with great care all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 带领（一般过去式 led the party up the north face：1978 年祖母头一回这样做，小心翼翼地）
B. v. 带领（一般现在 leads the party up the north face：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 带领（不定式 to lead the party up the north face：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 带领（过去完成时 had led the party up the north face：1972 年二月的日记上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 带领（动名词 leading the party up the north face 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 导致（lead to nothing but delay：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去导致只带来一场拖延）
G. v. 导致（lead to nothing but delay：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 带领（后段两处：新来的孩子照例 leads to nothing but delay，而母亲又一次 led the party up the north face）

answers.why: lead 意为“带领”，1978 年祖母小心翼翼地带领带着一行人上北坡，那是院子里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 led。
lead 意为“带领”，自那以后祖母当天就把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 leads。
lead 意为“带领”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯带领带着一行人上北坡”，此处为不定式 to lead the party up the north face。
lead 意为“带领”，日记里 二月 那行字说明早在 1985 年之前就有人带领过，故用过去完成时 had led。
lead 意为“带领”，祖母说“带领带着一行人上北坡这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 leading the party up the north face 作主语。
lead 意为“导致”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去导致只带来一场拖延”，should ever 之后用原形 lead to nothing but delay。
lead 意为“导致”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻导致只带来一场拖延（lead to nothing but delay at once），以后再也不要提起。
lead 意为“带领”，新来的孩子每个年头都照例导致只带来一场拖延，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 leads。
lead 意为“带领”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次小心翼翼地带领带着一行人上北坡，用一般过去式 led 叙述。
lead 意为“带领”，结尾那句是母亲 1990 年的话：要带领带着一行人上北坡，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和院子记住的那一件。

多年以后，祖母仍当天就做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（leads the party up the north face）

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 lead 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1978 the grandmother led the party up the north face with great care, and nobody in the courtyard forgot it.
Even now the grandmother leads the party up the north face on the same day whenever the courtyard asks.
Leading the party up the north face with great care, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever lead to nothing but delay on the same day, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new child from the next courtyard leads to nothing but delay with great care every year, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother led the party up the north face again, and the courtyard remembered that half.
